'''Jaekelopterus''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] arthropod from the [[wikipedia:Silurian|Silurian]] era, found in [[temperate]] freshwater or brackish [[lake]]s and [[river]]s. Despite their size, they are not butcherable or fishable, although they have the {{token|COOKABLE_LIVE|creature}} token (which serves no purpose, as they are not classified as vermin).

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] jaekelopterus for their ''beauty''.


{{D for Dwarf}}
Scientists say that it might have a taste for human flesh. Its preferences for dwarven flesh, or lack there of, are unknown as of now.
